shortDescription: Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 Exam City Details - Link Active. Exam date 22-23 September 2026. Direct link available for city and admit card details.
content:
Indian Air Force (Bhartiya Vayu Sena) has released the Exam City Details for the Agniveer Vayu Intake 02/2027 recruitment cycle.

The physical written / online exam is scheduled on 22–23 September 2026. The online application window started on 06 July 2026 and closed on 26 July 2026. The direct exam city details / information portal link is active below.

Check the exam city, date, and related instructions on the official portal using your registration number, enrollment number, or date of birth. Admit cards are usually released 24–48 hours before the exam date.
